review_type: Substantive self-critique, code audit and numerical verification; no separate reviewer agent
assessment: Complete execution of all eight 100000-update cells. Weight decay improved held-out accuracy and loss in every matched seed, but no run met the frozen delayed-grokking criterion within the horizon. All final float32 checkpoints and endpoint measurements passed independent verification. Five auxiliary float64 near-tie class changes were disclosed and bounded, with no change in correctness. Broader replication, later transitions and a second fresh full retraining remain unresolved.

resolved_findings.finding: The first marked attempt was terminated before qualification completed.
resolved_findings.resolution: Preserved the interrupted request and startup record, then issued separate recovery requests. No interrupted output was counted as a confirmation seed or complete experiment.

resolved_findings.finding: The MPS probe could not initialize under the supplied memory cap because its default low watermark was too high.
resolved_findings.resolution: Retained the failed request, used the valid CPU implementation, and qualified its steady-state cost before freezing confirmation. No memory or time limit was expanded.

resolved_findings.finding: A training-accuracy claim alone could be mistaken for generalization, or a late improvement could be labeled grokking after seeing curves.
resolved_findings.resolution: Froze separate memorization, held-out generalization and delayed-grokking definitions before confirmation; report right-censored missing events and a prespecified sensitivity grid.

resolved_findings.finding: Endpoint metrics or saved predictions could disagree with the actual saved model, split or optimizer update.
resolved_findings.resolution: Independently recompute endpoint measurements from logits, verify all labels and splits, reload every final checkpoint, check optimizer settings/update count, and run a second NumPy forward calculation from every final weight archive.

resolved_findings.finding: Wall-time segmentation could reset optimizer state or duplicate/omit learning-curve points.
resolved_findings.resolution: Save complete model and optimizer state with the exact update and curve; use new attempt IDs for segments. The pilot verified bitwise resumed training, and final verification checks the full 0:100:100000 cadence.

resolved_findings.finding: Historical preflight analysis referenced working endpoint files that changed when training resumed.
resolved_findings.resolution: Keep the original preflight output unchanged and resolve archival paths to checkpoint-derived snapshots at the original updates, requiring exact metric agreement. Preserve the exact preflight analysis source by checking its recorded source hash.

resolved_findings.finding: The measurement interchange requires curve records as a JSON list, while an internal summary used a file path.
resolved_findings.resolution: The final interchange embeds the complete curve list and also supplies curve_path. Package validation checks exact equality with the standalone curve and all required steps.

resolved_findings.finding: The first full-grid verification failed an exact-argmax assertion between float32 and auxiliary float64 forwards.
resolved_findings.resolution: Preserved the failed request and exact source; diagnosed five held-out ties or near ties, all between wrong classes. Kept bitwise float32 checkpoint equality and the existing NumPy logit tolerance. Replaced cross-precision exact-argmax identity with explicit disagreement reporting, a standard propagated float32 dot-product rounding bound, and unchanged classification correctness. No scientific protocol, model or retained prediction changed.

unresolved_findings.finding: Four seed pairs cannot support precise or distribution-free population inference.
unresolved_findings.consequence: The t interval is assumption-sensitive; the two-sided sign-flip reference test cannot attain p < 0.05 with four nonzero pairs. Do not use held-out example count as the replication count.
unresolved_findings.recommended_followup: A separately preregistered larger seed study with a budget adequate for the same fixed horizon.

unresolved_findings.finding: Right-censoring at 100,000 updates leaves later transitions unknown.
unresolved_findings.consequence: Absence of primary grokking within the study cannot establish that grokking never occurs. Endpoint improvement below 95% is a distinct result.
unresolved_findings.recommended_followup: An independently declared longer-horizon study, without retroactively changing this protocol.

unresolved_findings.finding: The three-evaluation sustain rule, 1,000-update delay and 50% gate are operational conventions.
unresolved_findings.consequence: Times are sampled at 100-update resolution and final short crossings cannot be confirmed; the sensitivity grid explores only selected alternatives.
unresolved_findings.recommended_followup: Compare justified alternative definitions prospectively without selecting one to favor a desired conclusion.

unresolved_findings.finding: Random ordered-pair holdout shares operands and sometimes reversed pairs with training.
unresolved_findings.consequence: This measures the prescribed within-modulus random-pair generalization, not unseen-number extrapolation or independent-example sampling. It cannot transfer directly to transformers, other moduli or training fractions.
unresolved_findings.recommended_followup: Separate tasks with explicitly grouped or operand-based splits, treated as new scientific questions.

unresolved_findings.finding: Each seed jointly varies the partition and initialization, and only two weight-decay values were studied.
unresolved_findings.consequence: Within-seed control supports the stated paired comparison but does not identify variance components, a dose-response relation, or an internal generalization mechanism.
unresolved_findings.recommended_followup: A separately designed crossed partition/initialization experiment and mechanistic diagnostics with adequate replication.

unresolved_findings.finding: Large unregularized logits and very small training losses make numerical scale relevant.
unresolved_findings.consequence: The float64 forward changed five near-tie choices between wrong classes; float32 checkpoint predictions remained bitwise exact and classification correctness was unchanged. Post hoc norms, ranges and rounding bounds do not establish a causal mechanism or equivalence to float64 training.
unresolved_findings.recommended_followup: Prospectively evaluate numerical precision and logit/weight dynamics without replacing the required float32 result.

unresolved_findings.finding: Full retraining in a second fresh environment and cross-platform reproducibility were not executed within this run's budget.
unresolved_findings.consequence: Reproduction is supported by executable orchestration, frozen dependencies, exact states and independent endpoint reloads, not a claim of an already completed second replication. Not every intermediate checkpoint was reloaded.
unresolved_findings.recommended_followup: Run the documented full reproduction command under a fresh authorized allowance on the same platform, then assess portability separately.
